🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 10, 2026

Moon, in Sagittarius, holds a trine to Neptune, in Aries. Both in fire, and speaking the same dialect: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a 2-week sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon trines you from Sagittarius, and the ease asks its own attention. Fire that starts things, started cheaply. The hold Mercury had a week ago is not there any more.

♉ TAURUS
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. From Scorpio, Mercury quotes your worth back at you. Earth holds on, and the holding is billed. Venus left Scorpio four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you from Scorpio on plain terms, without privilege. Moon faces you from Sagittarius, holding the other figures. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♋ CANCER
Moon, your ruler, crosses Sagittarius untitled. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. The conjunction to Jupiter that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun, your ruler, moves through Scorpio unannounced. Moon in Sagittarius sides with you before you have argued. Fire keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. Sun has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. From Sagittarius, Moon sets a figure against the wanting. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. Retrograde since three weeks ago, Mercury is still re-reading.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you and holds Libra by right, not by favour. Moon sextiles you from Sagittarius: a door left ajar. Air begins, and beginning asks little today. The conjunction of two weeks ago is off it now.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Water holds on until the thing and the self are one. New since last week: none of it is habit yet.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you and passes through Leo as a guest. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Mutable fire: the two accounts collapse into one. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. From Scorpio, Sun offers an angle — offered, not delivered. Cardinal earth: the opening move is the cheap one. It has stood two weeks; by now the cost is known.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon in Sagittarius opens a gap you have to step into. Fixed air: nothing needs letting go of today. Two weeks ago Saturn was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter rules you from Leo, untitled. Moon in Sagittarius stands at a right angle: friction, and a clear number. Water adapts, and every adaptation has a figure. What pressed a week ago has cleared.
